archetypes.name: container-app-sql
archetypes.description: Containerized app on the spoke's shared ACA environment + Azure SQL serverless (private).

containerImage.description: Any resolvable public image reference; references to the platform registry get automatic managed-identity pull (no credentials).

publicEndpoint.description: Explicit opt-in for an externally reachable endpoint. Default: internal-only ingress.

cpu.description: vCPU cores for the container (consumption profile).

memory.description: Memory for the container (must pair with a valid cpu value).

sqlAutoPauseDelayMinutes.description: Idle minutes before the serverless SQL database auto-pauses (compute cost drops to zero).

sqlMaxSizeGb.description: Maximum SQL database size in GB.
